listing.title: E Yacolt Road — 1.5 Acres
listing.description:
Explore a 1.5-acre, level parcel in Yacolt. The listing identifies C-1 zoning and commercial, multifamily and office uses. Parcel number: 067100000.

Disclosure: Brad Hazen, the listing agent, is the owner of this parcel. Discuss permitted uses, utilities and the source’s land-lease information with Brad before making plans.

Listing images may include map and street-view graphics. Boundary outlines are approximate and do not replace a survey.

listing.title: NE Hazen Avenue — 11.35 Acres
listing.address: 0 NE Hazen Ave, La Center, WA 98629
listing.description:
An 11.35-acre parcel near NE Hazen Avenue and NE 359th Street, with pasture, fir trees and valley views. The listing identifies R-5 zoning, gently sloping and rolling terrain, and parcel number 266970000.

The source description discusses potential division into two five-acre lots. Confirm current division eligibility, approvals, access and utilities with Brad and the appropriate authorities before relying on that possibility.

Listing images include approximate boundary outlines and map or street-view graphics; they do not replace a survey.
